description: This header file declares functions to construct message objects related to light events (addition, removal, update) for communication with a server. It is part of a larger SDK handling device light events.

methods.name: createLightAddedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a new light has been added.

methods.name: createLightRemovedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a light has been removed.

methods.name: createLightUpdatedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a light has been updated.
